text.rootboot.restart_required: Changes take effect only after restarting the game or server.
option.rootboot.time_offset.tooltip: Starts new worlds on day 1 by adding one day at world creation. Affects only worlds created afterwards; existing worlds are never changed.
option.rootboot.day_announcement.tooltip: Shows the global Overworld day on the action bar at dawn and when joining a world.
option.rootboot.level_milestone.tooltip: Plays a local animation when your experience level crosses a multiple of 5. Visible only to you and never triggered by level decreases.
option.rootboot.homing_experience_orb.to: Makes experience orbs pursue the nearest non-spectator player within 64 blocks after a short delay.
option.rootboot.death_item_protection.to: Prevents items dropped on death from despawning over time. They remain vulnerable to fire, lava, explosions, cacti, the void, and other hazards.
option.rootboot.biome_discovery.tooltip: Shows a local title the first time you enter each vanilla or modded biome.
